title: App research
description: Find the keywords an app ranks for, compare keyword coverage, and discover nearby competitors.

scope.title: Research scope
scope.description: Choose a registered app and store before running research.

preview.title: Confirm this lookup
preview.description: Review the account impact before the live lookup starts.
preview.remaining_zero: No units remain before this lookup.
preview.selfHost: This self-hosted deployment does not enforce a sold-plan allowance.

cache.cached: A cached result is available; the lookup still counts.
cache.mixed: The run combines cached and fresh data.
cache.unknown: Cache status will be resolved when the lookup runs.

keywords.title: Keywords for this app
keywords.description: See up to one hundred observed store-search keywords and positions.
keywords.limitNote: Results show observed ranks only. No volume or difficulty estimate is added.
keywords.caption: Observed store-search ranks for the selected app.
keywords.empty: This app did not rank for any observed keywords.

gap.marketNote: App research currently supports the United States in English. Other markets are unavailable.
gap.title: Compare keyword coverage
gap.description: Compare the selected app with up to nineteen competitor app IDs.
gap.placeholder: Enter one app ID per line
gap.invalidIds: Enter between one and nineteen valid competitor IDs for this store.
gap.caption: Observed rank for each app by keyword.
gap.empty: No shared or missing keyword opportunities were observed.

competitors.title: Discover competitors
competitors.description: Find up to one hundred related apps, then enrich the first fifty with ranking metrics in one lookup unit.
competitors.caption: Apps sharing observed ranking keywords with the selected app.
competitors.empty: No competitors were found for this app.
competitors.partialNote: Competitors were retained, but the metrics enrichment call failed. This lookup still counted.

empty.noProfileDescription: Add a Google Play package ID or App Store ID before running research.

disabled.title: New research is paused
disabled.description: Stored results remain available, but new lookups are disabled by the operator.

upsell.title: Add App SEO research
upsell.description: Your Pro plan needs the App SEO add-on or a research credit pack for these live lookups.

errors.requestFailed: The research request failed. Try again.
